$comment: ILLUSTRATIVE. Every company name, person and conversation below is invented for the blueprint. No real client of Forward AR Experts appears here. These rows exist so the access-boundary test has something private to try to leak, and so the review queue has something real to refuse.

signals.title: Discovery call notes (raw)
signals.raw_text: Discovery call, Northwind Grid Systems. Priya Raman (VP Product Marketing) said their last Magic Quadrant submission was set aside because two reference customers never confirmed in writing, and that the CFO now wants the analyst budget justified before the November inquiry. She asked for a briefing rehearsal and for help rebuilding the evidence pack.

deidentified_draft.title: Pattern: an evaluation submission set aside for unconfirmed references
deidentified_draft.text: A mid-size infrastructure vendor had an evaluation submission set aside because two reference customers had not confirmed in writing, and finance then asked for the analyst budget to be justified before the next inquiry. The ask that followed was a briefing rehearsal and a rebuilt evidence pack. Method note: run the written-confirmation check before the submission window opens, not after the deck is built.
removed: stated timing that identifies the account

signals.title: Pricing objection, raw thread (illustrative)
signals.raw_text: Halden Robotics thread: they want the retainer restructured around briefing cycles only, and they shared their internal board deck about the failed launch. Deck is confidential and must never leave the private board.

signals.title: Renewal risk note, raw (illustrative)
signals.raw_text: Corveil Health renewal at risk: their new CMO wants to cut analyst spend after the reorganisation, and the sponsor asked us not to mention the reorganisation to anyone outside the engagement.
